description: This file provides utility functions for splitting outbound text into platform-sized chunks, handling different chunking modes, paragraph and markdown-aware splitting, and fence-aware line breaking. It also includes configuration resolution for chunk size and mode based on provider and account settings.

methods.name: resolveChunkLimitForProvider
methods.description: Resolves the text chunk limit for a specific provider configuration and account ID.

methods.name: resolveTextChunkLimit
methods.description: Determines the effective text chunk limit based on configuration, provider, account, and fallback options.

methods.name: resolveChunkModeForProvider
methods.description: Resolves the chunk mode (length or newline) for a specific provider configuration and account ID.

methods.name: resolveChunkMode
methods.description: Determines the effective chunk mode based on configuration, provider, and account.

methods.name: chunkByNewline
methods.description: Splits text into lines based on newlines, with options for trimming, splitting long lines, and safe breakpoints.

methods.name: chunkByParagraph
methods.description: Splits text into paragraph-based chunks, respecting fenced code blocks and optional long paragraph splitting.

methods.name: chunkTextWithMode
methods.description: Dispatches text chunking based on the specified mode ('newline' or default).

methods.name: chunkMarkdownTextWithMode
methods.description: Splits markdown text into chunks, respecting paragraph boundaries and fence safety, based on mode.

methods.name: chunkText
methods.description: Splits text into chunks based on length, preferring line breaks and parentheses-aware splitting.

methods.name: chunkMarkdownText
methods.description: Splits markdown text into chunks, respecting fences and paragraph boundaries, with length fallback.
